about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Crafted with Excellence, World of Joy
about.introText:
Founded in 2000 and headquartered in Guangdong, China, StarJoy Amusement Rides Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive amusement ride manufacturer integrating R&D, design, production, sales, installation, and after-sales service. The company covers 200,000 square meters and features complete modern production facilities including large CNC machining centers, welding robot production lines, and painting workshops.

For over 20 years, we have始终坚持 technological innovation as our core driving force, obtaining more than 50 national patents. Our products are certified by ISO9001, CE, and TUV international certifications. Our product range covers eight major series including rotating rides, track rides, water rides, and children's rides, with over 200 varieties exported to more than 50 countries and regions.

news.news1Desc: StarJoy Amusement Rides has officially signed with a major Dubai cultural tourism group to build a 50,000 sqm theme park with a total project value of 230 million CNY.

news.news2Desc: StarJoy's self-developed X-series smart roller coaster has successfully passed EU CE safety certification, marking domestically produced high-end rides reaching international standards.

news.news4Title: StarJoy Recognized as National High-Tech Enterprise
news.news4Desc: Through continuous R&D investment and technological innovation, StarJoy has successfully passed the national high-tech enterprise certification.
news.news5Title: Kids' Ride Series Gets Comprehensive Upgrade
